notices.body:
The Senate stands adjourned until 10:15am on Wednesday, September 30, 2026.

Following Leader remarks, the Senate will be in a period of morning business with senators permitted to speak therein for up to ten minutes each.

During Monday’s session, Senator Thune filed cloture on the following:

Motion to proceed to Cal. #548 H.R.7008 , Stop Insider Trading Act

Motion to proceed to Cal. #684 H.R.9340 , Ratepayer Protection Act

Executive Calendar #912 Keith Sonderling, of Florida, to be Secretary of Labor

At approximately 11:30am, the Senate will vote on the motion to invoke cloture on the motion to proceed to Cal. #548 H.R.7008 , Stop Insider Trading Act. If cloture is not invoked, the Senate will vote on the motion to invoke cloture on the motion to proceed to Cal. #684 , H.R.9340 Ratepayer Protection Act. If cloture is not invoked, the Senate will vote on the motion to invoke cloture on Executive Calendar #912 Keith Sonderling, of Florida, to be Secretary of Labor.

Additional roll call votes are possible during Wednesday’s session.

Wednesday, September 30 th at approx. 11:30am – up to 3 roll call votes:

Motion to invoke cloture on the motion to proceed to Cal. #548 H.R.7008 , Stop Insider Trading Act

Motion to invoke cloture on the motion to proceed to Cal. #684 , H.R.9340 , Ratepayer Protection Act

Motion to invoke cloture on Executive Calendar #912 Keith Sonderling, of Florida, to be Secretary of Labor

notices.body:
The Senate stands adjourned as a further mark of respect to the memory of former Senator Nancy Kassebaum until 10:00am on Tuesday, September 29, 2026.

Following Leader remarks, the Senate will be in a period of Morning Business with Senators permitted to speak therein for up to 10 minutes each.

The Senate will recess from 12:30pm until 2:15pm to allow for weekly caucus meetings.

If Senator Baldwin or her designee makes a motion to proceed to Cal. #456 , S.J.Res.197 , A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services of the Department of Health and Human Services relating to "Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, HHS Notice of Benefit and Payment Parameters for 2027; and Basic Health Program”, the Senate will vote on the motion at 2:15pm.

During Monday’s Session Senator Thune filed cloture on the following items:

Motion to proceed to Cal. #548 H.R.7008 Stop Insider Trading Act

Motion to proceed to Cal. #684 , H.R.9340 Ratepayer Protection Act

Executive Calendar #912 Keith Sonderling, of Florida, to be Secretary of Labor

The Senate stands adjourned until 3:00pm on Monday, September 28, 2026.

Following Leader remarks, the Senate will resume consideration of Cal. #449 S.4668 , Protect College Sports Act, as amended, post-cloture.

Passage of Cal. #449 S.4668 , Protect College Sports Act, as amended
